accessories.name: Mana Flower
accessories.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
accessories.why: Auto-using mana potions makes mage much easier to pilot and keeps your attention on dodging.

accessories.name: Hermes Boots
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: Movement is survival in early Terraria, and Hermes Boots give you the speed to dodge, kite, and position better.

accessories.name: Cloud in a Bottle
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: The double-jump makes cave traversal and emergency boss repositioning much easier.

accessories.name: Band of Starpower
accessories.source: Found in Shadow Orbs / Crimson Hearts
accessories.why: +20 max mana for early casters.

accessories.name: Lucky Horseshoe
accessories.source: Found in Skyware Chests and Sky Crates
accessories.why: It lets you use height aggressively for kiting without losing runs to fall damage.

buffs.name: Mana Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Speeds up mana regeneration, so you stop to drink fewer mana potions.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Lesser Mana Potion
buffs.source: Purchased from the Merchant, or found in Wooden and Pearlwood Crates from fishing
buffs.why: A healthy stack keeps your early magic weapons usable during longer fights.

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: Mage has less room for mistakes, so the bonus defense matters a lot.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.why: The global stat bump is easy to maintain and always worth it.

buffs.name: Mana Potion
buffs.source: Crafted, or found in most Crates
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Magic Power Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

items.name: Aglet
items.source: Found in Chest and 2 other sources
items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 5%.

items.name: Climbing Claws
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
items.why: Allows the player to slide down walls.

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.
items.notes: If acquired early, the Fledgling Wings' vertical mobility is significantly improved with the Frog Leg.

items.name: Extra jump
items.why: Allows the player to perform a double-jump.

items.name: Flying Carpet
items.source: Crafted
items.why: Enables the player to briefly hover.

items.name: Fledgling Wings
items.source: Found in Azure Crate and 2 other sources
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.notes: If acquired early, the Fledgling Wings' vertical mobility is significantly improved with the Frog Leg.

items.name: Shiny Red Balloon
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop
items.why: Increases jump height of the player.

items.name: Anklet of the Wind
items.source: Found in Bramble Crate and 2 other sources
items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 10%.

items.name: Panic Necklace
items.source: Crafted at Tinkerer's Workshop and Ecto Mist
items.why: Briefly increases the player's movement speed after they take damage.

items.name: Shackle
items.source: Dropped by Frozen Zombie and 2 other sources
items.why: Increases the player's defense by 1.

items.name: Band of Regeneration
items.source: Found in Gold Chest and 1 other source
items.why: Increases the player's passive health regeneration by 1 HP/s (which ignores the effects of the Bleeding debuff).

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.source: Dropped by Blood Zombie and 1 other source
items.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration.

items.name: Celestial Magnet
items.source: Found in Azure Crate and 2 other sources
items.why: Greatly increases the pickup range of mana stars.

items.name: Nature's Gift
items.source: Found growing on Jungle grass in the Underground Jungle
items.why: Reduces mana cost by 6%.

weapons.name: Abigail's Flower
weapons.source: Found growing on grass near a placed Tombstone
weapons.why: Summons Abigail, a single ghost minion that grows stronger with each re-summon.

weapons.name: Finch Staff
weapons.source: Found in Living Wood Chests
weapons.why: Summons a Baby Finch minion and is a common starter summon weapon.

weapons.name: Flinx Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at Work Bench
weapons.why: Summons a Flinx minion; Flinx Fur drops from Snow Flinxes in the Snow biome.

weapons.name: Vampire Frog Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Zombie Merman and Wandering Eye Fish (Blood Moon)
weapons.why: Summons a Vampire Frog minion; obtainable during a Blood Moon with no boss required.

weapons.name: Cobwhip
weapons.source: Crafted at Loom
weapons.why: Cheapest early whip.

weapons.name: Leather Whip
weapons.source: Purchased from the Zoologist (10 Gold)
weapons.why: Bought from the Zoologist and directs minions onto the struck target.

weapons.name: Snapthorn
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Jungle-material whip that inflicts Acid Venom and grants summon tag damage.

weapons.name: Cattiva
weapons.source: Found during the day on surface grass, Jungle grass, Snow or Ice (guarded by two Goblin Archers)
weapons.why: Summons a single Cattiva minion that also mines and cuts trees near the player.

weapons.name: Foxparks
weapons.source: Found during the day on surface grass, Jungle grass, Snow or Ice (guarded by two Goblin Archers)
weapons.why: Summons a single Foxparks minion with a held flamethrower attack.

weapons.name: Slime Staff
weapons.source: Rare drop from most slimes, Slimed Zombies, and King Slime
weapons.why: Summons a Baby Slime minion; has one of the lowest drop rates in the game.

accessories.name: Hermes Boots
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: Movement is survival in early Terraria, and Hermes Boots give you the speed to dodge, kite, and position better.

accessories.name: Cloud in a Bottle
accessories.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests
accessories.why: The double-jump makes cave traversal and emergency boss repositioning much easier.

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle Chests, Ivy Chests and Jungle Crates
accessories.why: The melee speed and autoswing boost noticeably improves several early melee weapons.

accessories.name: Band of Regeneration
accessories.source: Found in Underground Chests
accessories.why: The passive healing is small on paper but adds up fast when paired with campfires and heart lanterns.

accessories.name: Lucky Horseshoe
accessories.source: Found in Skyware Chests and Sky Crates
accessories.why: It lets you use height aggressively for kiting without losing runs to fall damage.

buffs.name: Summoning Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: The extra minion slot is too valuable to skip, even in the earliest summoner boss prep.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Brewed at Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.why: You are still fragile even with summons doing the work, so extra defense is welcome.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Well Fed
buffs.why: It is a painless always-on stat boost for a class that wants every slot and every edge.

mixNote: The Flinx Fur Coat is the chest piece, not an extra layer - it replaces whatever shirt you are wearing. That costs nothing here, because the ore sets have no set bonus to break, and it is the only summon damage available before the first boss.
